description: This file defines the class SineVoice, a subclass of SawVoice, which overrides the method createOscillator() to return a SineOscillator instance, replacing a sawtooth wave with a sine wave oscillator.

classes.name: SineVoice
classes.description: A subclass of SawVoice that generates sine wave oscillations by overriding createOscillator()

methods.name: createOscillator
methods.description: Overrides the method from SawVoice to return a SineOscillator instead of a sawtooth oscillator
